newsitem.title: USA: Command Security says resolves liabilities.
newsitem.headline: Command Security says resolves liabilities.

text.p: - Command Security Corp said on Thursday that a claim arising from injuries allegedly sustained as the result of an assault by one of the company's guards, which created a $12 million contingent liability, has been resolved by its insurance carrier for $175,000 with no further liability. The remaining unaccrued portion of its risk retention, $7,500, has been accrued in the financial statements for the third quarter ended Dec. 31st, 1996, the company said.

The company also said that in addition to the retirement of 238,000 shares of its common stock in connection with the recently announced settlement with International Service System Inc, another 152,774 shares will be retired by the end of the fourth quarter as a result of a breach of contract claim by a former employee. The combined effect of the retirement of the shares will be to reduce the number of outstanding shares by five percent, the company said.
Earlier in the week, the company reported third quarter earnings of $0.09 per share, compared with $0.10 per share for the year-ago period.
